facts.text: Malaysia includes territory on the Malay Peninsula and Borneo.
The South China Sea separates its two main regions.
Kuala Lumpur is the national capital.

culture.text: Dikir barat is a Malay vocal tradition performed by groups, sometimes with percussion.

food.name: Laksa
food.text: This family of noodle dishes takes markedly different forms in places such as Penang and Sarawak.
